title: Large Language Models Transform Organic Synthesis: From Reaction Prediction to Automation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the out-of-distribution accuracy drop (30-40%) when models attempt to generalize to novel or niche chemical reactions (e.g., photoredox catalysis, electrocyclic rearrangements) compared to heavily overrepresented and well-studied reactions (e.g., cross-couplings) in the chemical training corpora.
